entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Smt. Shaitan Bai Ganguly And Others
 Versus
 Rajesh And Others
 Appearance:
Shri Vinay Puranik, learned counsel for the petitione  ORDER Heard on I.A. No.12482/2024.
There is delay of 450 days in filing the present restoration application.
The applicant has explained the delay by stating that the applicant is an illiterate poor, ill, aged widow.
Thus, she could not arrange the funds for filing the restoration application.

2. It has also been stated that earlier, the applicant had filed this present MCC (MCC No.4488/2024) for restoration of M.A. No.4086/2024 but the same was dismissed on 17.06.2025 due to peremptory order dated 15.04.2025.

Thereafter, another MCC bearing MCC No.4520/20285 was filed for restoration of the present MCC (MCC No.4488/2024) but, the same was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 17.12.2025 and then, another MCC bearing MCC No.21/2026 was filed for restoration of present MCC (MCC No.4488/2024) which was allowed vide order dated 27.01.2026 and the present MCC was restored and listed today for consideration of NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:9022 2 MCC-4488-2024 restoration of original miscellaneous appeal i.e. M.A. No.4086/2024.

3. It has been further stated that the office has counted the days of delay in view of the period of filing applications and its dismissal and subsequent filing application which has caused delay of 450 days in the matter.
Whereas, the actual restoration application was filed within a period of three months and few days.
4. Considering the same, the delay in filing the present MCC is condoned and I.A. No.12482/2024 stands allowed and disposed of.

Considering the fact that the applicants are poor persons and in original proceedings, an appeal has been filed against the award under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act claiming compensation for the death of husband of applicant No.1, the present MCC Smt. Shaitan Bai Ganguly vs Rajesh on 6 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25536345/
1 No.4488/2024 is allowed.

5. As regards interest, in case, the amount of compensation is enhanced then this Court may consider for excluding the period for which the appeal remained dismissed.
6. With the aforesaid, present MCC stands disposed of.

7. Let a copy of the order be placed in MA No.4086/2024 also.
(PAVAN KUMAR DWIVEDI) JUDGE N.R.
